title: Central Water Commission (CWC)
definition: The Central Water Commission (CWC) is a premier technical organization in India in the field of Water Resources, functioning as an attached office of the Ministry of Jal Shakti, Government of India.
importanceInUpsc: CWC is critical for GS Paper III (Environment/Disaster Management) and GS Paper II (Governance/Inter-state water disputes). It is the nodal agency for flood forecasting, dam safety, and national water policy implementation.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Central Water Commission.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Constitutional provisions on Water (Entry 17, State List; Entry 56, Union List)
